title: 2.0 WHICH ENTITIES ENTITLED TO A DUTY DRAWBACK. - Uganda Revenue Authority

# 2.0 WHICH ENTITIES ENTITLED TO A DUTY DRAWBACK.
According to Section 139(1) of EACCMR 2010 a manufacturer intending to claim for DDB shall apply for registration. It’s only the registered manufacturer who has fulfilled all the requirements that can claim for DDB after export.
